You read a process description in which one decision is marked [D] and what follows it is marked [1], [2], and so on: steps of the process, and further decisions.

For each marked step, say whether it is done
- "yes": only in the case named last before it: the condition of [D], or of a later decision you marked "same",
- "no": only when the condition of [D] does not hold, for example after "otherwise",
- "after": after the decision, whatever its outcome.

For each marked decision, say whether it is
- "same": another case of the decision [D] ("If it is not in stock" after "If it is in stock"),
- "after": a decision of its own, taken after [D] is settled.

The first item you mark "after" ends the decision: mark it and every later item "after". If the words of [D] do not choose between alternatives at all, mark every item "after".

Example.
Text: The clerk checks the invoice. [D]If the amount exceeds 500 euros, the manager [1]approves it; otherwise the clerk [2]approves it. Then the invoice is [3]paid.
Decision [D]: If the amount exceeds 500 euros
Marked:
[1] Approves it (The manager)
[2] Approves it (The clerk)
[3] Paid the invoice
Answer: {"reasoning": "The manager approves large amounts and the clerk the others; the invoice is paid in both cases.", "step_1": "yes", "step_2": "no", "step_3": "after"}

Example.
Text: [D]If the item is in stock, the clerk [1]ships it. [2]If it is not in stock, the clerk [3]orders it and [4]informs the customer. The clerk then [5]sends the invoice.
Decision [D]: If the item is in stock
Marked:
[1] Ships it (The clerk)
[2] decision: If it is not in stock
[3] Orders it (The clerk)
[4] Informs the customer (The clerk)
[5] Sends the invoice (The clerk)
Answer: {"reasoning": "[2] is the other case of the stock decision; ordering and informing belong to it; the invoice is sent in both cases.", "step_1": "yes", "step_2": "same", "step_3": "yes", "step_4": "yes", "step_5": "after"}

Example.
Text: [D]If the order is urgent, the clerk [1]calls the courier. [2]If the customer is abroad, the clerk [3]fills in a customs form.
Decision [D]: If the order is urgent
Marked:
[1] Calls the courier (The clerk)
[2] decision: If the customer is abroad
[3] Fills in a customs form (The clerk)
Answer: {"reasoning": "Whether the customer is abroad does not depend on urgency: [2] is a decision of its own.", "step_1": "yes", "step_2": "after", "step_3": "after"}

Answer with JSON only: a short "reasoning", then one key per marked item, "step_1" to "step_N".

Text: A loan application is approved if A loan application passes two checks: (i) the applicant’s loan risk assessment, done automatically by a system, and (ii) the appraisal of the property for which the loan has been asked, carried out by a property appraiser. The risk assessment requires a credit history check on the applicant, which is performed by a financial officer. Once both the loan risk assessment and the property appraisal have been performed, a loan officer can assess the applicant’s eligibility. [D]If the applicant is not eligible, the application is [1]rejected, otherwise the acceptance pack is [2]prepared and [3]sent to the applicant.
Decision [D]: If the applicant is not eligible
Marked:
[1] Rejected the application (A loan officer)
[2] Prepared the acceptance pack (A loan officer)
[3] Sent (A loan officer)
